concept.hr: Ubrzanje ograničava dio programa koji se ne može ubrzati
concept.en: Speedup is limited by the part of a program that cannot be sped up

summary.hr: Ubrzaj pojedine dijelove programa i gledaj ukupno ubrzanje, usko grlo i granicu 1/s; na grafu Amdahl i Gustafson.
summary.en: Speed up single parts of a program and watch the overall speedup, the bottleneck and the 1/s ceiling; Amdahl and Gustafson on a chart.
